Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

The Global Threat Assessment Program (GTAP) provides 24/7 investigations and behavior-based threat assessments to guide Airbnb's response to ongoing critical safety incidents. Working across three regions (AMER, EMEA, and APAC), GTAP responds to ongoing threats of violence, stalking, harassment, and other serious safety incidents, partnering closely with Law Enforcement Operations, Legal, and Customer Support to mitigate threats to our platform and communities.

The Difference You Will Make

The Regional Operations Manager for the GTAP is responsible for overseeing day-to-day operations within their assigned region. This role is crucial in ensuring the safety and security of Airbnb's community within the region. You will lead a regional team of threat assessment managers, set and manage team performance expectations, and serve as the expert voice on high-threat incident deescalations.

A Typical Day

· Oversee the daily operations of the GTAP within the assigned region, ensuring alignment with Airbnb’s mission and vision.

· Manage threat assessment cases end-to-end within the region: triage incoming reports, investigations and structured threat assessments, develop incident management plans, and drive cases to resolution.

· Maintain rigorous case documentation in accordance with GTAP standards — every decision must be explainable, consistent, and auditable.

· Maintain regional situational awareness: track developing situations, and ensure relevant information reaches the appropriate GTAP and GSRM stakeholders in a timely way.

· Coordinate with the Global Operations Manager and other Regional Operations Managers to ensure consistency and effectiveness across all regions.

· Track regional caseload metrics: volume, time-to-triage, time-to-resolution, and SLA adherence. Provide accurate regional data to the Global TAO Manager for program-wide reporting.

· Identify regional throughput issues or patterns — spikes in case type, emerging threat profiles, recurring escalation triggers — and raise them with analysis and proposed action.

· Establish and maintain partnerships with local stakeholders to assess Airbnb’s methodology of managing threatening incidents and to exchange threat information to reduce and minimize risks to the Airbnb community within the region.

· Manage regional Global Safety and Security team relationships with local law enforcement partners and other investigative, research, and intelligence groups and vendors.

Your Expertise

· 5+ years of experience in threat assessment, investigations, law enforcement, intelligence, or a closely related field.

· Hands-on threat assessment case experience: you have independently triaged, assessed, and managed cases involving targeted violence, stalking, harassment, or comparable subjects

· Solid documentation discipline: you write clear, accurate case notes that stand up to legal and operational scrutiny.

· Clear written and verbal communication: you can summarize a complex, sensitive case for a non-expert stakeholder and present a recommended action with confidence.

· Background in law enforcement, corporate security, intelligence, or a technology company trust and safety function with a case management component.

· Experience in a globally distributed team with cross-regional collaboration.

Mastery of open source research and online investigative techniques.

· Ability to build partnerships and work collaboratively and cross-functionally.

· Creative and entrepreneurial mindset with a positive attitude and hunger for learning.

· Willingness and ability to travel within the region as needed.

· Demonstrated commitment to Airbnb’s core values.

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states.

This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com . Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

Datadog is seeking a Regional Manager, Sales Engineering to join our high-growth organization and world-class pre-sales team.

You will manage a team of talented Sales Engineers to help qualify and close opportunities and coach the team on their approach to providing technical expertise through sales presentations, product demonstrations, and supporting technical evaluations (POCs).

This is a hands-on management role where you will take the lead technical role in your region supporting customer facing activities and engagements for key accounts. Enable a strong partnership between the SE team and other organizations within Datadog.
At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

Partner with the Sales Team to articulate the overall Datadog value proposition, vision and strategy to customers.
Manage a team of leaders and individual contributors, helping to ensure customer success pre-sale;
Assist recruiting efforts to find and hire top talent within your region. Mentor/coach new hires during on-boarding to ensure proper ramping of skills and capabilities
Ensure that your team is enabled to support all required Datadog solutions along with key technical and soft skills
Develop a close working relationship with Product Management, Support, and Enablement to ensure continuity between pre and post sales activities
Deliver semi-annual performance reviews along with collaborating on and executing individual development plans

Experienced with 1-3+ years in a Sales Engineering team lead or mentorship role and 3+ years in a Sales Engineering or other equivalent client facing role
Coachable, with a strong desire to improve and grow as a professional and a demonstrated ability to navigate through change
Proven in your ability to grow and develop a team
Experienced in recruiting both individual contributors and front line leaders
Knowledgeable in current infrastructure and monitoring solutions and technologies
Able to build and execute an evaluation plan with a customer and mentor others on how to do so
Someone with strong written and oral communication skills. This role requires an ability to understand and articulate both the business benefits (value proposition) and technical advantages of our offering while also coaching others how to do so
Able to think strategically and creatively about a wide variety of challenges
Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.
Best-in-breed onboarding

Intra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking
New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)
Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing
An inclusive company culture, able to join our Community Guilds and Inclusion Talks
Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.
The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

As a key member of the Flexport team, you will take on the role of a people leader, responsible for managing a process and a team on the operating floor. This position offers a unique opportunity to invest in others and cultivate a collaborative leadership style.

By utilizing the tools, processes, and operations that drive Flexport's mission to make global trade easy for everyone, you will contribute to shaping the future of logistics. We are looking for high-potential candidates who are eager to take on this challenge and be part of our dynamic and innovative organization.

Join us in our mission to revolutionize global trade and make a lasting impact on the industry.

Coach, manage, and develop a team of 30-100.
Communicate policies to your team and act as the primary information source for the team, maintaining compliance, consistency, and taking corrective action when needed.
Create, manage, and support recognition programs across your department.
Support all safety programs and OSHA compliance to ensure a safe work environment for all associates.
Ensure procedures are followed for building security and product loss prevention.
Be an integral part of our Operations team as an Area Manager of one of our largest fulfillment partners located across the country.
Own performance reporting for your areas of responsibility within the FC, including, but not limited to, on-time receiving and shipping, inventory accuracy, and packing quality.
Consistently hold yourself and your team to strict SLA expectations, providing clear and concise verbal and written reports of performance and action plans when needed.
Facilitate troubleshooting with relevant cross-functional parties for fulfillment-related problems.
Serve as an escalation point to mitigate risks and resolve issues.
Measure and respond to gaps in inventory accuracy, facilitating strategic initiatives to identify root causes and resolve them.
Review defect rates to identify trends and expose opportunities to improve operations both internally and across the network.
Track learnings and best practices to contribute to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
Help prioritize the resolution of systemic problems, working closely with our Growth and Engineering teams.

2+ years managing staff of 5 or more.
Must be able to lift up to 49 pounds with or without reasonable accommodation.
Must be willing and able to frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach.
Must be able to stand/walk for up to 10-12 hours.
Must be able to work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud.
Must be able to work in an environment where the temperature may vary between 60 and 90 degrees and will occasionally exceed 90 degrees.
Must be able to work on a secure mezzanine at a height of up to 40 feet (applies to buildings with mezzanines). This position requires a candidate with the proven ability to drive process improvements and the ability to keep pace with our growth while motivating others to meet challenges in a deadline-driven environment.
Willing and able to work any permanent shift that may include overnights and holidays. Note that there is a high chance that your shift may overlap into part of the weekend.
Demonstrated collaboration with internal and external business partners to deliver greater operational performance, efficiency, and quality.
Precise communication around external partner decisions, issues, risks, and new processes.
Keen ability to distinguish internal versus external problems causes to properly focus the correct resources to resolve issues quickly.
Exceptional prioritization skills to ensure timely resolutions that are appropriate for the severity and impact of the situation.
Experience leveraging problem-solving and data analysis skills to drive high judgment decisions.
Strong presentation and interpersonal skills.
Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, ambiguous, deadline-oriented work environment.
Ability to adapt in a rapid growth, startup environment.
Strong problem-solving skills.
Great attention to detail + appreciation for the complexity associated with the consistent achievement of operational tasks.
Personable and collaborative; strong affinity for working cross-functionally.
Strong computer literacy skills, including usage of Google Sheets/Excel.
Incredibly hardworking and willing to do what it takes for us to reach our goals.
Experience in warehousing, fulfillment, or transportation/logistics management.
Experience working with SQL, creating and running reports.

No prior warehouse or management experience is required — we provide structured training. What matters most is that you've led before: on a team, in a club, on campus, in the military, or in a part-time job — and that you're excited to keep developing that skill in a fast-paced, hands-on environment where you'll help shape how Flexport moves global trade forward.
This role is onsite in Phillipsburg, NJ.
You Will
Coach, manage, and develop a team of 30–100 (with training and support from your site leadership as you ramp up).
Communicate policies to your team and act as the primary information source for the team, maintaining compliance and consistency, and taking corrective action when needed.
Create, manage, and support recognition programs across your department.

Measure and respond to gaps in inventory accuracy, helping identify root causes and resolve them.
Review defect rates to identify trends and surface opportunities to improve operations, both internally and across the network.
Track learnings and best practices to contribute to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
Help prioritize the resolution of systemic problems, working closely with our Growth and Engineering teams.

A bachelor's degree completed within the last 12 months, or expected within the next few months.
Demonstrated leadership experience — this can come from campus organizations, athletics, ROTC/military, student government, internships, or part-time or summer jobs. Formal people-management experience is not required.
Strong problem-solving skills and comfort learning new processes quickly in a fast-paced, sometimes ambiguous environment.
Strong computer literacy, including comfort with Google Sheets/Excel.
Clear, confident written and verbal communication skills.
A collaborative, personable approach with a strong affinity for working cross-functionally.
Great attention to detail and an appreciation for the complexity behind consistent day-to-day operations.
Willingness and ability to work any permanent shift, which may include overnights, holidays, and weekend overlap.
Must be able to lift up to 49 pounds with or without reasonable accommodation.
Must be willing and able to frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach, and to stand/walk for up to 10–12 hours.
Must be able to work in an environment where noise levels and temperature vary (60–90°F, occasionally higher).
Must be able to work on a secure mezzanine at a height of up to 40 feet (applies to buildings with mezzanines).

Who We Are
Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together . We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.
Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era.

From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

We’re looking for a Country Manager to be the single-threaded owner of establishing and growing Notion’s presence in Italy. This is a market-building leadership role. You will create initial market momentum, convert early demand into lighthouse customer wins, and install a repeatable operating system that scales.
Think of it as building a startup within Notion: you will own Notion's mission delivery and revenue maximization in-country — partnering closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Professional Services, and other teams to maximize impact. You'll operate with a high degree of autonomy in local decision-making, while staying tightly aligned with global and regional strategy. You'll report to the EMEA GM.

You will be accountable for all revenue of the Italy business
Deeply understand existing and prospective Notion users in-market — their workflows, use cases, and unmet needs — and translate those insights into a market strategy
Build momentum in the local ecosystem through community, startups, strategic partnerships, and customer advocacy
Establish Notion’s brand presence in-market and represent Notion as the public face across press, events, and executive conversations
Partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Customer Success, Solution Engineering, and Professional Services to ensure customers achieve meaningful outcomes with Notion
Actively seek opportunities to engage, promote, and grow Notion’s presence across Italy and the broader EMEA region
Build a repeatable operating cadence for market planning, customer insight, pipeline generation, and performance tracking

Mission-driven founder energy: You are inspired by Notion's mission to help people build beautiful tools for their life's work, and you bring a founder-like commitment to growing the business. You've built 0→1 in a market or segment, thrive in ambiguity, and have high agency. Hands-on — running events, quarterbacking deals, writing the playbook
Technical and AI fluency: Credible demoing Notion + AI Agents, and discussing integrations and workflows with technical audiences
Locally embedded: You have a deep network in Italy across startups, VC, community, media, and enterprise leaders
Ecosystem builder: You build partner loops and repeatable programs, not one-off events
Public face: Comfortable with press, podcasts, conferences, and founder/CxO conversations. Credible with startup founders and enterprise executives alike
Strong GTM collaboration: You make the ecosystem motion measurable through routes, follow-ups, and handoffs to regional teams
Sales leadership: Proven ability to build and lead a strong sales team that consistently delivers revenue results
Data-driven operator: You bring a data-driven mindset to planning, goal-setting, and tracking progress. You know how to build and run a scorecard, analyze performance, and make clear investment recommendations

10+ years of professional experience, with a strong track record in sales, business development, or market-building roles, including 3+ years in a people management role
Experience working in and managing the Italian market, ideally across startup, mid-market, and enterprise segments
Comfortable with the ambiguity and pace of iteration of an early-stage operation
Strong empathy for customers and passion for revenue and growth
Fluent in Italian and English; proficiency in additional regional languages is a plus
Deep understanding of the Italian SaaS, technology, startup, and enterprise ecosystem

Experience at a high-growth SaaS/AI company operating in Italy or Southern Europe
Experience selling or evangelizing productivity, collaboration, or developer tools
Track record of building and scaling community-led or product-led growth motions
Experience partnering with regional marketing, customer success, solution engineering, and professional services teams to build a market
You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results

Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.
We are seeking a Regional Director, Commercial Sales, ASEAN to lead our Commercial Sales team across ASEAN. Based in our Singapore office, this is a first-line sales leadership role responsible for hiring, coaching, and developing a team of Commercial Account Executives focused on winning high-growth digital native businesses across the region.
You will own the strategy and execution for a high-potential Commercial segment focused on fast-growing digital native, startup, and application-layer companies across ASEAN. To do it, we're designing a dynamic culture where employee development, well-being, and safety come first. It's why we've become the #1 home solar and battery company in America.

We're unlike any other residential energy company. Our vertically integrated model gives us total control over every part of the energy lifecycle - from sale through installation and beyond - so you can find endless opportunities for growth. Come join a career you can grow in and a culture you can run with.

Who We Are We're on a mission to make energy more reliable and affordable for more people. We provide an opportunity with storage and solar to help people access greater energy independence without the big upfront costs.

Sunrun is the largest dedicated residential solar and storage company in the country and has a mission to bring stably priced resilient power to the masses.

Overview The Clean Energy District Manager is an in-field role requiring regular visits to our Retail partner stores to coach, support and manage your team of Clean Energy Ambassadors who work onsite in the Retail locations.

Regularly attend all required meetings and training Maintain staff retention at Sunrun defined levels, ensuring employee satisfaction and career growth Support regional and national leadership in rolling out new processes and change management Operationalize productivity-enhancing plays locally and provide feedback to guide regional and national process improvement efforts Meet or exceed all team and individual sales goals Provide the green for our customers and bring home the green for you and your family Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent Minimum of 2 Years of direct people management experience required, with proven record of meeting team performance standards Minimum of 3 years prior experience in a quota-driven sales position highly preferred We need experienced, people managers who know how to coach and develop a successful team.

s.h: Für einen Mandaten suchen wir folgende Position
s.t: Das Unternehmen ist ein etablierter deutscher Produzent von kundenspezifischen Industriekomponenten in einem äußerst spannenden Marktumfeld. Mit über 100 Mitarbeitenden und einer diversifizierten Kundenbasis bietet es alle unternehmerischen Chancen für eine dynamische Unternehmensentwicklung. Der Private-Equity-Gesellschafter unterstützt die Entwicklung aktiv und fördert eine unternehmerische Kultur mit viel Freiraum und der Möglichkeit, neue Ideen und Konzepte in die Umsetzung zu bringen.

Gemeinsam mit dem bestehenden Geschäftsführer und der zweiten Führungsebene gilt es, das volle Potenzial des Unternehmens auszuschöpfen. Der bestehende Geschäftsführer verantwortet Markt, Vertrieb, Kunden und die strategische Geschäftsentwicklung.

Als CFO/COO übernehmen Sie Finanzen/Controlling , Einkauf, Produktion und Konstruktion sowie die operative Transformation . Dabei liegt es an Ihnen, Abläufe und Prozesse zu verbessern und neu einzuführen, Ihre Teams zu begeistern und Probleme analytisch zu erfassen, Lösungen zu erarbeiten und diese schnell in die Umsetzung zu bringen.

Es geht nicht darum, perfekte Prozesse zu schaffen, sondern pragmatisch und unternehmerisch zu denken. Tiefgehende Erfahrung im Change-Management, unternehmerischer Geist sowie eine strukturierte und verbindliche Arbeitsweise zählen dabei mehr als Detailwissen oder Branchen-Know-how.

Der Schwerpunkt der ersten 12 Monate liegt auf der Stabilisierung und Professionalisierung des Unternehmens als eigenständige Einheit. Anorganisches Wachstum über Zukäufe ist eine wichtige mittelfristige Perspektive**.**
Aufgaben
Weiterentwicklung und Professionalisierung des Finanzbereichs – zunächst durch die Definition und Verbesserung von Prozessen, Verantwortlichkeiten, Stammdaten und Steuerungslogiken, anschließend durch die Auswahl und Einführung eines passenden ERP-Systems
Neustrukturierung einer motivierten Produktion nach Effizienzgesichtspunkten zur Margensteigerung; die heutigen Prozesse sind noch stark handwerklich geprägt
Steigerung von Produktivität, Durchlaufzeiten, Termintreue, Qualität und Liefertreue durch Weiterentwicklung der Fertigung nach pragmatischen Lean-Grundsätzen und ein verbindliches operatives KPI-System
Vorantreiben des Umbaus von einer aufwendigen Losgröße-1-Fertigung/-Konstruktion hin zu einer modularen, automatisierten Prozesskette
Professionalisierung von Beschaffung, Lieferantenmanagement & Lagerhaltung
Aufbau eines durchgängigen Projekt- und Auftragsmanagements vom Auftragseingang bis zur Abnahme
Qualifikation
Sie sind eine unternehmerische, hands-on geprägte Führungspersönlichkeit und haben nachweislich und messbar ein mittelständisches Industrieunternehmen operativ und finanziell weiterentwickelt . Veränderungen setzen Sie auch gegen Widerstände durch und kommunizieren gegenüber den Gesellschaftern transparent und verbindlich.

Sie benötigen keine großen Teams oder Assistenzstrukturen – aus Ihrer Erfahrung, Ihrer unternehmerischen Ausstrahlung und Ihrer Verbindlichkeit heraus führen und motivieren Sie Ihr Team, treffen aber bei Bedarf auch harte Entscheidungen.

Als Generalist(in) mit einem analytischen und strukturierten Geist können Sie mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig steuern und liefern Ergebnisse. Sie gehen souverän mit Rückschlägen um, lernen aus Fehlern und behalten dabei stets Ihren kontinuierlichen Verbesserungswillen.

Sowohl im Finanzbereich als auch in der Produktion kennen Sie die wesentlichen Abläufe und wissen, wie moderne und erfolgreiche Prozesse aussehen müssen. Sie scheuen keine Konflikte und können auch mit Widerstand professionell umgehen.
Sie haben in vergangenen Positionen genau diese Persönlichkeitsmerkmale unter Beweis gestellt und können Ihre Erfolge anhand konkreter Kennzahlen belegen. Erfahrung mit Private-Equity-Gesellschaften und Unternehmenszukäufen bringen Sie bereits mit – insbesondere praktische Erfahrung in Due Diligence, 100-Tage-Programmen und Integration und nicht nur in der Begleitung von Transaktionen.

Neben einem attraktiven Gehalt, Bonus und den üblichen Komponenten möchten wir vor allem Persönlichkeiten ansprechen, die unternehmerisch und langfristig denken. Durch eine äußerst attraktive Beteiligungsstruktur können Sie überproportional partizipieren und direkt am von Ihnen geschaffenen Mehrwert monetär teilhaben.

From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.
As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust.

It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies. We’re looking for a Regional Director, Enterprise Sales to lead and scale a team of high-achieving, high-integrity Enterprise Account Executives focused on driving new business and expansion opportunities across Fivetran’s most strategic accounts. This role reports directly to the RVP of Enterprise Sales and will be a foundational leader in our Enterprise business.
This is a full-time, remote position and must be based out of NJ, NY, CT, or DC in the United States.

Attract, hire, develop, and empower a team of Enterprise Account Executives to consistently and predictably exceed Fivetran’s growing Enterprise revenue targets
Drive a high-accountability culture through best-in-class coaching, modeling clear expectations for achievement, and evangelizing a disciplined process for the team
Champion outstanding sales rigor through value-based Command of the Message and MEDDPICC methodologies
Collaborate cross-functionally with leaders in Marketing, Customer Success, Alliances, Product, and Revenue Operations to build an effective
Enterprise GTM motion Collaborate externally with our incredible ecosystem of partners including SI’s, GSI’s, and tech partners
Ensure excellence in sales execution for complex multi-stakeholder deals while building the foundation for growth in enterprise accounts
Drive AE-ownership of Enterprise pipeline generation and encourage effective AE/BDR collaboration to efficiently prospect, identify, qualify and build sustainable pipeline
Forecast clearly to the executive leadership team, with consistent accuracy and a deep knowledge of the Enterprise business
Work in lockstep with our technology and SI partners to achieve a successful co-selling motion

5+ years enterprise sales leadership experience with a consistent track record of recruiting and retaining high-performing senior AEs selling a technical solution to large, complex enterprises
Proven and repeatable history of overachievement both as an enterprise seller and a leader whose teams consistently exceeded revenue targets and accelerated their careers under your leadership
Natural ability to lead and motivate AEs through continuous growth and change; easily able to earn the trust and respect of the team with a One Team One Dream mindset Passion for field sales — a leader who can’t wait to jump into deals, connect directly with Economic
Buyers, and provide the air coverage and executive bridging needed to close new and expansion opportunities with Enterprise companies.
This includes working with reps and prospects/customers/partners face to face wherever possible
Experience partnering cross-functionally and co-selling with external partners to build an Enterprise business from the ground up
Expertise in both land and expand sales motions, an insatiable curiosity about our customers, and a data-backed vision for how Fivetran can drive positive business outcomes in the Enterprise business
Experience building and championing an outbound selling culture and driving accountability for qualified pipeline generation Unwillingness to settle for good results when great results are possible
Bonus Skills ​
Experience with a consumption business is a plus!
Demonstrated ability to leverage the power of AI to drive a richer, more robust sales motion.
This position qualifies for Fivetran’s incentive plan, and it’s common for employees in this role to achieve the total on-target earnings.
As part of our commitment to setting new hires up for success, all new sales team members attend a one-week, in-person Revenue Bootcamp during their second week at Fivetran. This bootcamp, held at one of our designated company locations, requires travel and is a mandatory part of the onboarding process.

Deine Rolle
Als Area Manager in unserem Werk in Barleben bei Magdeburg stellst du sicher, dass dein Produktionsbereich während der Schicht reibungslos funktioniert und die gesetzten Produktivitäts-, Qualitäts-, und Sicherheitsziele jederzeit erreicht werden.

Dabei coachst und leitest du dein Team kontinuierlich an und sicherst mit einem kollaborativen Führungsstil, dass das Team zur Erreichung der Ziele optimal zusammenarbeitet. Zudem überwachst und optimierst du Einsatzpläne, Prozesse und Arbeitszuschnitte in deinem Bereich kontinuierlich und regst Veränderungen an und/oder setzt diese um.
Dein Verantwortungsbereich
Als Area Manager führst du ein Team, bestehend aus 5 Supervisor, welche jeweils ca. 20–25 Shopfloor Mitarbeiter fachlich anleiten. Ziel ist stets alle Key Performance Indicators zu erreichen und bestenfalls zu übertreffen.
Durch effektives Coaching und ein ausgezeichnetes Leistungsmanagement deiner Mitarbeitenden stellst du eine optimale Zielerreichung sicher.
Du trägst die Verantwortung für die operative Performance in deinem zugewiesenen Bereich und sorgst für einen reibungslosen Ablauf
Du optimierst die Ressourcennutzung und arbeitest eng mit Teamleitungen und interdisziplinären Teams zusammen.
Du schaffst eine positive Arbeitsumgebung, die Produktivität, Teamgeist und Mitarbeitereinbindung fördert. -
Du verbesserst und optimierst operative Prozesse, um Effizienz, Produktivität und Kostenersparnis zu steigern.

Abgeschlossenes Bachelorstudium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung in der Logistik, Produktion oder einem Fulfillment-Center; Erfahrung in der Lagerlogistik ist ein Plus.
Erste Erfahrung in der Führung von Mitarbeitenden.
Idealerweise Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Warehouse-Management-Systemen (WMS).
Sicherer Umgang mit KPIs zur Steuerung operativer Prozesse.
Fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse in Excel, Google Sheets sowie idealerweise Grafana und Tableau.
Analytische Denkweise und datenbasierte Entscheidungsfindung.
Fließende Deutschkenntnisse sowie Englischkenntnisse auf mindestens B2-Niveau.
Kommunikationsstärke, Eigeninitiative und Teamgeist.
Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit.

Einen Wohlfühlarbeitsplatz mit einem tollen Team in Barleben bei Magdeburg
Rabatte auf unsere HelloFresh Kochboxen
Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch interne Trainings
Ein umfassendes Onboarding
Ein kompetitives Gehalt und ggf. Schichtzulagen
30 Tage Urlaub
Spaß bei Teamevents
Vergünstigte Fitnessangebote bei Urban Sports Club bzw. John Reed
Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
Selgros Karte
Persönliche Sicherheitsausrüstung

Why Charlie Health?

Millions of people across the country are navigating mental health conditions, substance use disorders, and eating disorders, but too often, they’re met with barriers to care. From limited local options and long wait times to treatment that lacks personalization, behavioral healthcare can leave people feeling unseen and unsupported.

Charlie Health exists to change that. Our mission is to connect the world to life-saving behavioral health treatment. We deliver personalized, virtual care rooted in connection—between clients and clinicians, care teams, loved ones, and the communities that support them. By focusing on people with complex needs, we’re expanding access to meaningful care and driving better outcomes from the comfort of home.

As a rapidly growing organization, we're reaching more communities every day and building a team that’s redefining what behavioral health treatment can look like. If you're ready to use your skills to drive lasting change and help more people access the care they deserve, we’d love to meet you.

This role is a rare chance to lead the go-to-market efforts for one of the fastest growing startups in the healthcare industry. You'll be granted an unparalleled level of responsibility, as your efforts will define how we open and win in new markets.

As a Regional Director, it will be your responsibility to manage a state-wide or multi-state region, supporting the Directors and Managers that represent Charlie Health in the region.

You'll work hand-in-hand with our leadership team to identify patient referral sources, build relationships with clinical partners, and facilitate admissions for hundreds of at-risk youth. You'll obsess (in a healthy way) over ensuring that every possible patient, parent, and provider is aware of Charlie Health’s programs.

Our team is comprised of passionate, forward-thinking professionals eager to take on the challenge of the mental health crisis and play a formative role in providing live-saving solutions. We are looking for a candidate who is inspired by our mission and excited by the opportunity to build a business that will impact millions of lives in a profound way.

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Als Regional Manager:in verantwortest du unsere Zugpersonale in der Region Berlin. Du sorgst für ein motivierendes Arbeitsumfeld, entwickelst dein Team weiter und stellst gemeinsam mit verschiedenen Schnittstellen einen erstklassigen Service für unsere Fahrgäste sicher. Dabei verbindest du operative Exzellenz mit einer Hands-on-Mentalität und trägst maßgeblich zum Erfolg unseres wachsenden Bahnunternehmens bei.

Über die Rolle

· Du verantwortest unser Team von bis zu 50 Zugpersonalen in und um Berlin

· Durch regelmäßigen Austausch und eine offene Kommunikation schaffst du eine gute Arbeitsatmosphäre sowie positive Teamkultur

· Als zentrale Ansprechperson begleitest du Mitarbeitende in ihrer fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung und verantwortest das Abwesenheitsmanagement

· Gemeinsam mit dem Recruiting Team unterstützt du den weiteren Ausbau des Teams sowie einen erfolgreichen Onboarding-Prozess neuer Kollegen und Kolleginnen

· Mit einem klaren Blick auf Qualität, Service und Kennzahlen stellst du die Einhaltung unserer Betriebsstandards sicher und entwickelst das Reiseerlebnis für unsere Fahrgäste kontinuierlich weiter

Über Dich

· Du hast eine betriebliche Ausbildung im Bahnumfeld oder Personenschienenverkehr abgeschlossen, idealerweise im Fernverkehr

· Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im operativen Bahnbetrieb, beispielsweise als Zugführer:in, Zugbegleiter:in, Zugdisponent:in oder in einer vergleichbaren Funktion, bringst du bereits mit

· Idealerweise konntest du bereits erste Erfahrung in der Führung oder Entwicklung von Mitarbeitenden sammeln

· Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (Mindestens C1-Niveau) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse für die Zusammenarbeit in einem internationalen Umfeld gehören zu deinem Profil

· Du bist bereit gelegentlich innerhalb Deutschlands zu reisen

· Eine strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität zeichnen dich aus

· Kommunikationsstärke, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Freude daran, Menschen zu motivieren und weiterzuentwickeln runden dein Profil ab

In this role, you will join the Bank’s new place‑based (Local Growth) team, taking responsibility for shaping and directing place‑based activity within the North East Region.
Working locally and in close partnership with the North East Director, you will develop a tailored regional strategy and delivering meaningful outcomes by engaging with the local market investment teams, central resources, and drawing on your own personal commercial experience.

This includes identifying, catalysing, and facilitating commercial opportunities focused on the region’s priority Industrial Strategy sectors, including connecting finance providers with clusters of high‑potential businesses to drive measurable growth in local financing and business activity.

A core element of the role is fostering a local finance ecosystem that enables innovative, high‑potential businesses to access the right finance, regardless of location or stage of development. The position also leverages the Bank’s expertise in small business access to finance, alongside its extensive networks of finance providers and investors.

You will need to establish credibility quickly with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders, from investment professionals to local leaders and politicians, in order to facilitate the development, negotiation and implementation of initiatives that drive change and growth within the region.

You will bring commercial experience in accessing and/or delivering equity or debt finance, together, with a credible technical and strategic understanding of how investment decisions are made and how capital flows into local markets. This experience may have been gained within a finance provider, or as a founder or business operator.

You will also have a proven ability to act as a strategic partner to external stakeholders, influencing decision‑makers at both operational and strategic levels. Experience of working with, convening and developing investor networks would be a distinct advantage.

Excellent analytical capability is essential, including confidence in working with quantitative and qualitative data to produce compelling, insightful materials that inform strategy, support stakeholder engagement, and contribute to the delivery of measurable and impactful outcomes.

You will play a leading role in convening investors across the North East, strengthening connections between private capital, public finance institutions, innovation clusters and high-growth businesses, while helping to attract new sources of investment into the region.

s.h: Are You the Leader We're Looking For?
s.t:
As Managing Director at Unit8 , you won't just close deals — you'll be a cornerstone of how we grow and deliver Data & AI transformation for pharma clients across the DACH market.

As we reorganize into verticals and horizontals, this role sits at the center of our pharma vertical: you own both sides of the equation — originating high-value client relationships and ensuring delivery actually moves the needle.

If you've built your career at the intersection of commercial impact and technical credibility in life sciences, and you're ready to operate with real autonomy in an expert-led environment, this is the role.
What Success Looks Like in This Role
This is a senior leadership position for someone as comfortable originating a complex engagement as overseeing its delivery — with pharma as a main focus. You shape and close the deal, build relationships and trust with pharma decision-makers, and stay close enough to ensure technical execution delivers real value. You will succeed by:
Building and converting a pipeline of high-value opportunities in DACH pharma — through a network earned over years of credible data & AI work in the sector
Selling from expertise: pharma clients engage with you because you understand their regulatory, R&D, and commercial challenges firsthand — not because you have a polished pitch
Staying embedded in delivery long enough to set the right pace, challenge client assumptions, and keep teams focused on the actual business problem
Bridging the gap between data scientists/engineers and a pharma C-suite conversation — translating technical constraints into strategic decisions and vice versa
Raising the delivery bar by knowing what good looks like in pharma data & AI, and holding teams to that standard

Leverage your existing pharma network to source, shape, and close high-value engagements in DACH (new logos, not just expansions)
Translate complex pharma business problems — from R&D data strategy to commercial analytics to regulatory-grade AI — into concrete Data & AI solutions, and hold clients accountable to realizing that value
Lead and shape complex, tech-enabled transformations across the pharma value chain — from early problem definition through scaled delivery — ensuring technology choices serve the business outcome, not the other way around
Act as the senior point of contact for key pharma clients throughout delivery, keeping technical execution anchored to business value
Challenge clients when necessary — on scope, pace, and ambition
Work closely with our engineering and data science teams (a horizontal you'll draw on across verticals), providing pharma business context, removing blockers, and coaching them

You've run complex, tech-enabled transformations in pharma — from a top-tier global consultancy or a specialist data & AI firm. You've navigated high-stakes, ambiguous engagements through to delivery, with the results to show for it.
Significant experience in Data & AI consulting for pharma/life sciences, with a clear and verifiable track record of personally originating and closing major client relationships in the sector
Currently at Principal or Associate Partner / Director level — or equivalent — with the commercial track record and client ownership, looking for the next step
You don't need to write code, but you must "speak Tech" — understanding data architecture and AI well enough to raise our delivery bar and earn the respect of world-class engineers
An established network of senior client relationships in DACH pharma

s.h: Fluent in English. German and/or French (nice to have)
s.t: Comfortable traveling, including e.g. on-site engagements in the US (up to 5 weeks)

What's In It For You
At Unit8, we don't just "turn data into value" — we empower the people who make it happen. If you are looking for a place where you can say, "I am independent and I take ownership", your next chapter starts here.
Trust from Day One: We believe in your expertise, and trust is a core part of our culture.
Work that Matters: You will do things that matter, and together we will facilitate the work of others.
Passion-Led Projects: We create an environment where you can pursue your passion alongside great talent. If the future makes you excited, you belong here.
Impact: You will be part of our leadership team and have a direct hand in shaping how Unit8 grows in the DACH market — defining our commercial approach, influencing which industries and clients we focus on, and setting the standard for how we deliver. This is not an execution role inside a fixed strategy; you help write it.

Flexibility & Growth: Above-the-norm flexibility on where and when you work, with up to 10% of your time dedicated to learning and pro-bono projects.
Connection & Fun: Whether it's our cross-office off-sites, online events, or a dedicated quarterly team budget for after-work activities, we make sure we stay connected.
We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. If you meet the qualifications and are excited about the opportunity to contribute to our team, we encourage you to apply.

Hisense USA partners with the nation’s leading retailers — including Walmart, Sam’s Club, Best Buy, Costco, Amazon, and Lowe’s — to bring award-winning products and premium in-store experiences to American consumers.

Locations:Remote (US) with positions in several regions: California, Upper Midwest, Great Lakes/Ohio Valley, Northeast, and Southeast with occasional travel to Alpharetta, GA office Job Overview: The Regional Manager plays a pivotal role in enhancing Hisense’s presence within Best Buy stores by guiding and supporting the Best Buy employees funded by Hisense.

This is leadership without a badge of authority: the specialists you develop don’t report to you, so your influence, coaching, and credibility are what turn training into product knowledge, product knowledge into better customer conversations, and better conversations into Hisense TV and soundbar sales.

Indirect leadership: Influence without direct authority — aligning specialists and store teams with Hisense’s sales strategies, priorities, and standards.
Store visits: Conduct regular store visits across your region to assess performance, deliver coaching, influence product placement and merchandising compliance, and implement development plans.
Performance management: Monitor KPIs for product knowledge, sales techniques, and customer engagement; track and report on team progress, training effectiveness, and sales outcomes.
Partner collaboration: Collaborate with Best Buy store and market management and Hisense internal teams to resolve issues and identify opportunities; serve as the voice of the specialist back to Hisense leadership.
Regional planning: Develop and execute regional action plans to boost product visibility, display compliance, and sales performance.
Compliance: Ensure compliance with company policies, program requirements, and retail best practices.

Minimum of 6 years of multi-unit retail management experience; proven retail background required, consumer electronics highly desirable but not mandatory.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the demonstrated ability to influence and motivate teams you don’t directly manage.
Willingness to travel extensively (60–70%) across the assigned region; valid driver’s license and reliable transportation required.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and sales tracking tools.
Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, field-based environment.
College degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field preferred but not required.

Experience in vendor-funded retail programs or partnerships.
Knowledge of TV and audio product categories.
Demonstrated success in team development and performance improvement.

About Ted
TED is on a mission to discover and spread ideas that spark imagination, embrace possibility, and catalyze impact. Our organization is devoted to curiosity, reason, wonder, and the pursuit of knowledge — without an agenda. We welcome people from every discipline and culture who seek a deeper understanding of the world and connection with others, and we invite everyone to engage with ideas and activate them in your community.
About The Audacious Project
The Audacious Project is a collaborative funding platform that invites visionary changemakers to imagine their boldest ideas to solve the world’s most urgent challenges.
Housed at TED, the nonprofit dedicated to the belief that ideas change everything, Audacious works to surface ideas that are breathtakingly ambitious yet achievable and brings together a community of philanthropists to unlock the funding needed to make them real.

Each year, Audacious selects a cohort of extraordinary leaders from around the world — visionaries with proximity to the problems they're solving, and bold plans to shift systems, lift up communities, and contribute to a healthier planet.
Since its launch in 2018, Audacious has helped to catalyze more than $8B for over 70 projects across a range of issue areas. Rooted in TED's belief that ideas can come from anywhere, Audacious focuses on the strength of the idea and the team behind it, not a fixed issue area. Funded projects span science, climate, technology, health, social safety net and justice.
Job Description
Role Description
The Managing Director, Discovery and Insight leads Audacious's global search for ambitious ideas and changemakers — finding, testing, and building the case for the ideas and leaders most worth backing each funding cycle. This role owns end-to-end curation, application, and diligence activities, ultimately leading to recommendations for the cohort of finalists selected annually.
The Managing Director's work is centered on: a strategy informed by continuous learning about systems-level impact and Audacious' unique role within it; deep collaboration with applicants, donors, and partners nurtured over time; and leadership of a strong team to sustain the work.
Each year, the Discovery and Insight team conducts a global search to identify nonprofit ideas that are:
Innovative and offer a unique approach to a significant problem with the potential to shift the status quo or the system they operate within
Proximate & Community-Oriented in leadership and decision-making structure (i.e., led by those who intimately understand the problem/opportunity, incorporating impacted communities in decision-making, led by someone who has direct experience in/with the community served)
Approaching an inflection point or needing a significant capital inflow to catalyze a differentiated level of impact that they haven’t received support for yet (rather than support for ongoing operations)
Thoughtfully ambitious ideas that both inspire and convince — have an exciting, breakthrough vision (‘inspire’), clear outcomes, and evidence that the idea will have a significant and concrete impact (‘convince’)

Set and evolve the sourcing and curation strategy.
Advance sourcing and curation strategy for each cycle, forming a clear point of view on where Audacious should be learning, looking, collaborating, and why, ultimately carrying that strategy forward across cycles
Develop a “future-oriented” approach by monitoring and anticipating emerging trends and innovations that Audacious actively engages with or responds to
Actively capture insights and lessons learned to refine and improve Audacious's sourcing and curation activities annually
Lead selection and diligence.
Apply the sourcing and curation strategy to identify the ideas most worth Audacious's attention - deciding what advances into the application stage, and bringing along multiple stakeholders and inputs along that decision-making process
Lead diligence on selected organizations, rigorously testing readiness, viability, and fit within Audacious's portfolio
Build the recommendation — evidence, rationale, and risks included — that carries an idea into finalist selection
Cultivate and steward the partners who bring ideas to Audacious.
Surface strong ideas by building genuine, ongoing relationships with social sector leaders, including funder and intermediary partners (incl. sourcing networks, collaboratives, and others)
Steward key partner relationships by developing a deep understanding of each stakeholder’s goals, priorities, and aspirations
Maintain stakeholder relationships continuously, within and across cycles, to ensure trust and rapport among all actors
Represent Audacious's point of view in the field, using that standing to draw the most ambitious organizations and ideas toward the platform and to create richer opportunities for sector collaboration
Build and nurture a team that explores the frontier of audacious social change.
Lead the Discovery and Insight vertical and its resourcing strategically, matching capacity to where the real work sits and bringing in the right technical expertise when needed
Develop people who can source, diligence, and hold partner relationships credibly in their own right — building a team of strong practitioners so Audacious's discovery capacity grows beyond any single person
Effectively steward relationships and actively collaborate with key Audacious partners (e.g., The Bridgespan Group) with whom we partner year-round

Health Resources in Action, Inc. (HRiA) is a non-profit organization working to improve and reimagine public health. We connect, consult, and collaborate to solve complex challenges of access and equity in our health and social systems. Together with our partners, clients, and collaborators, we create actionable solutions so that all people can thrive.
In 1957, The Medical Foundation (TMF) was created to primarily fund biomedical research in Massachusetts. Since then, we’ve been on a journey of evolution. We changed our name to Health Resources in Action (HRiA) to reflect our impact in the field of public health. Today, HRiA works with individuals, organizations, and communities to drive a policy and systems change approach to advance health and racial equity.
HRiA seeks sustainable solutions for complex problems using an anti-racist approach. We aim to be adaptable and flexible in meeting clients and partners where they are, offering our decades of knowledge and resources to collectively realize our dream of equitable, sustainable health for all. The foundation of this work is centered on our values:

Health and racial equity by identifying and addressing the root causes of health inequities, intentionally working to shift narratives and power imbalances and disrupt all systems of oppression.

Leading with heart by demonstrating our passionate commitment to our work, continuously challenging ourselves with humility and vulnerability while pursuing and holding ourselves accountable to our mission.

Collaboration by intentionally and respectfully leading, partnering, and following to strengthen relationships, uplift different voices and build trust.

Innovation by driving toward new strategies, questioning norms, and continuously learning and evolving to support the needs of our clients and communities.

HRiA offers exciting, engaging, and challenging employment opportunities for facilitators, trainers, researchers, analysts, policy specialists, grant managers, and more. People come to HRiA because of our commitment to advancing health equity and inspiring work; they stay for our wonderful clients, partners, and dedicated and dynamic staff.

With our growing portfolio of high-impact work, person-centered policies, and generous benefits, our team continually invests in making HRiA a great place to work. Our diverse staff of over 270 people hail from 30+ states, with a homebase in Boston’s Chinatown neighborhood.
HRiA’s core services include: (1) public health services (PHS), (2) capacity building assistance (CBA), (3) research and evaluation, (4) health and racial equity, and (5) grantmaking for biomedical research and community health initiatives.

VONTAI implementiert künstliche Intelligenz (KI) direkt in die operativen Prozesse inhabergeführter mittelständischer Unternehmen. Statt theoretischer Konzepte oder reiner Beratungsfolien liefert VONTAI konkrete, DSGVO-konforme und produktive KI-Lösungen — von agentenbasierten Workflows über automatisierte Abläufe bis hin zur sicheren Einbindung in bestehende Systemlandschaften. Ziel ist es, Teams spürbar zu entlasten, Prozesse zu optimieren und messbaren wirtschaftlichen Nutzen zu stiften.

Der deutsche Mittelstand steht vor der Herausforderung, den digitalen Wandel und den Einsatz von KI rasch umzusetzen. Während das Bewusstsein für die Chancen hoch ist, fehlen in vielen Betrieben interne Ressourcen, technische Spezialist:innen und klare, rechtssichere Pfade zur Implementierung.

VONTAI adressiert genau dieses Marktversagen als pragmatischer Umsetzungs- und Sparringspartner auf Augenhöhe („Liefern statt Beraten“), um KI als nachhaltigen Wettbewerbs- und Effizienzfaktor im Mittelstand zu verankern.
Aufgaben
Deine Hauptverantwortlichkeiten und typischen Aufgaben
Unternehmensaufbau & -steuerung: Gesamtheitliche operative und strategische Führung des Unternehmens in engem Schulterschluss mit den Gesellschaftern.
Vertrieb & Business Development: Aktive Nutzung und Weiterentwicklung von Sales-Kontakten, Akquisition neuer B2B-Mandate im Mittelstand sowie Führung von Verkaufsgesprächen bis zum Abschluss.
Kundenführung & Bedarfsanalyse: Sichere Begleitung von Entscheidungsträgern durch Analyse-, Erstberatungs- und Umsetzungsphasen sowie Übersetzung komplexer Anforderungen in konkrete KI-Projekte.
Delivery & Projektsteuerung: Steuerung der Projektumsetzung in Zusammenarbeit mit einem Netzwerk aus deutschsprachigen IT- und Projektmanagement-Spezialisten.
Skalierung & Produktisierung: Entwicklung von standardisierten, wiederholbaren Leistungsangeboten und einem skalierbaren Delivery-Modell aus individuellen Kundenprojekten.
Ergebnisverantwortung: Sicherstellung von Qualität, messbarem Kundennutzen, Projektmargen sowie dem wirtschaftlichen Gesamterfolg.
Organisationsentwicklung: Schrittweiser Aufbau von internen Strukturen, klaren Prozessen und einer leistungsorientierten Firmenkultur.
Qualifikation
Anforderungsprofil (Was du mitbringst)
Erfahrung
Praktische Erfahrung in der Einführung von KI-Lösungen in Unternehmen, idealerweise bis zur produktiven Nutzung.
Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Führung von B2B-Projekten und Projektmanagement-Methodiken.
Idealerweise Führungserfahrung als Geschäftsführer, Unternehmer oder Bereichsleiter im Mittelstand.
Erfahrung in der aktiven Gestaltung organisatorischer Veränderungsprozesse.
Qualifikationen & Skills
Tiefes Verständnis für KI-Agenten, LLM-Anwendungen, Automatisierung und sichere KI-Architekturen.
Kompetenz in Daten- und Datenschutzanforderungen (DSGVO).
Souveränität im B2B-Vertrieb: Fähigkeit, erklärungsbedürftige Leistungen zu verkaufen und zum Abschluss zu bringen.
Exzellente kommunikative Fähigkeiten, um komplexe technologische Themen wirtschaftlich verständlich zu machen.
Unternehmerische Persönlichkeit mit hohem Verantwortungsbewusstsein ("Ownership"), Zielstrebigkeit und Durchsetzungsstärke.
Fähigkeit, externe Spezialisten, Kunden und perspektivisch ein Team verbindlich zu führen.

Attraktives Vergütungspaket: Fixgehalt von 60.000 bis 120.000 EUR (abhängig von Erfahrung und Nachweisen) sowie ein starker Gewinnbonus mit bis zu 200.000 EUR Erfolgspotenzial.
Echte Beteiligung & Partnership: Klar definierte Perspektive auf Unternehmensanteile (Equity) bei nachhaltigem Aufbaubeitrag.
Unternehmerischer Freiraum: Volle Gestaltungsfreiheit und grüne Wiese beim Aufbau eines neuen Unternehmens ohne bürokratische Hürden.
Starkes Backup & Netzwerk: Direkter Zugang zu erfahrenen Mittelstands-Gesellschaftern, bestehenden Sales-Kontakten und einem etablierten Pool an IT- und Projektmanagement-Experten.
Flexibles Work-Setup: Moderne, hybride Arbeitsmodelle, hochmoderne Tool-Landschaft und freie Wahl der Arbeitsmittel.
Zukunftsthema Nummer 1: Echte Pioniermöglichkeit, KI im Mittelstand produktiv zu verankern und einen sichtbaren Markteinfluss zu nehmen.
Baue mit uns das nächste große KI-Unternehmen für den Mittelstand.
Wir suchen keine Mitarbeiter_innen. Wir suchen Mitgründer_innen im Kopf – Menschen, die nicht nur Ideen haben, sondern liefern. Wenn du Bock hast, von Tag eins an mitzugestalten statt nur mitzulaufen, und dabei auch noch am Erfolg beteiligt zu werden: lass uns reden.
Kein Anschreiben, kein Lebenslauf-Bullshit-Bingo. Schick uns einfach deinen CV oder dein LinkedIn-Profil – der Rest ergibt sich im Gespräch.

Kennenlernen (30 Min.) – Kurz, unkompliziert, auf Augenhöhe. Wir klären, ob's menschlich und fachlich passt, und beantworten deine ersten Fragen.
Deep Dive mit den Gesellschaftern – Hier geht's ans Eingemachte: Geschäftsmodell, Zielkunden, Strategie – und vor allem, wie viel Gestaltungsspielraum konkret für dich drin ist.
Persönliches Treffen & Finale – Wir setzen uns zusammen, sprechen über Beteiligung und Vergütung und machen es offiziell.
Klingt nach dir? Dann warte nicht auf die perfekte Gelegenheit – das hier ist sie gerade.

Workdate bringt Menschen in Unternehmen zusammen. Unsere Software hilft Organisationen dabei, Silos aufzubrechen, Wissen zu teilen und über Abteilungen, Standorte und Hierarchieebenen hinweg echte Verbindungen zu schaffen.
Ob Lunch Roulette, virtuelle Kaffeepausen, Mentoring oder Lerngruppen: Workdate organisiert Begegnungen intelligent und weitgehend automatisiert.
Heute nutzen Unternehmen im Mittelstand und Konzernumfeld Workdate, um Zusammenarbeit und Unternehmenskultur nachhaltig zu stärken. Mit mehr als 500 Kunden und 250.000 Nutzer:innen weltweit haben wir eine starke Basis geschaffen. Nun suchen wir eine unternehmerisch denkende Persönlichkeit, die Workdate in die nächste Wachstumsphase führt. Mehr über Workdate
Aufgaben
Als Geschäftsführer:in übernimmst du die operative und strategische Gesamtverantwortung für Workdate. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Gründerteam, dem Team und unseren Partnern die nächste Wachstumsphase – mit einem klaren Blick auf Kunden, Produkt, Umsatz und nachhaltige Unternehmensentwicklung.
Du verbindest strategisches Denken mit konsequenter Umsetzung. Dabei arbeitest du nah am Markt, verstehst die Anforderungen von HR-Verantwortlichen und Entscheidern und kannst aus Kundenbedürfnissen überzeugende Angebote, Produktentscheidungen und skalierbare Prozesse ableiten.
Unternehmensstrategie weiterentwickeln: Du schärfst die Positionierung von Workdate und übersetzt sie in konkrete Ziele, Prioritäten und Maßnahmen.
Wachstum verantworten: Du steuerst Umsatzentwicklung, Neukundengewinnung, Bestandskundenausbau und strategische Partnerschaften im B2B-SaaS-Umfeld.
Vertrieb aktiv vorantreiben: Du führst wichtige Kundengespräche selbst, entwickelst den Sales-Prozess weiter und baust eine belastbare Pipeline auf.
Kundenbeziehungen ausbauen: Du pflegst den direkten Austausch mit HR-Verantwortlichen und Entscheidern, verstehst deren Herausforderungen und stärkst langfristige Kundenbeziehungen.
Produktentwicklung mitgestalten: Gemeinsam mit dem Produkt- und Entwicklungsteam priorisierst du Anforderungen und entwickelst Workdate markt- und kundenorientiert weiter.
Organisation und Team führen: Du schaffst klare Verantwortlichkeiten, etablierst wirksame Prozesse und entwickelst eine vertrauensvolle, leistungsorientierte Remote-Kultur weiter.
Unternehmenskennzahlen steuern: Du verantwortest Planung, Budget, Liquidität und Reporting und leitest aus den relevanten Kennzahlen fundierte Entscheidungen ab.
Workdate nach außen vertreten: Du repräsentierst das Unternehmen gegenüber Kunden, Partnern, Netzwerken und weiteren relevanten Stakeholdern.
Qualifikation
Uns ist wichtiger, was du aufgebaut und erreicht hast, als ein bestimmter Abschluss.
Mehrjährige operative Verantwortung in einem Start-up, Scale-up, SaaS-Unternehmen oder einer vergleichbaren unternehmerischen Rolle.
Nachweisbare Erfahrung in mindestens zwei der Bereiche Geschäftsführung, B2B-Vertrieb, Business Development, Produktstrategie oder Customer Success.
Freude daran, selbst Kundengespräche zu führen, Abschlüsse voranzutreiben und Verantwortung für Ergebnisse zu übernehmen.
Klare, verbindliche und wertschätzende Kommunikation
Strukturierte, eigenständige Arbeitsweise in einem Remote-first-Umfeld
Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und sehr gutes Englisch
Interesse an HR Tech, Employee Experience, Organisationsentwicklung und der Zukunft der Zusammenarbeit
Du musst nicht jede Anforderung erfüllen. Entscheidend sind unternehmerischer Gestaltungswille, Lernfähigkeit und der Wunsch, Workdate langfristig weiterzuentwickeln.

Echte unternehmerische Verantwortung: Du gestaltest Strategie, Produkt, Organisation und Wachstum maßgeblich mit.
Bewährtes Produkt mit Substanz: Du startest mit einer etablierten B2B-SaaS-Lösung, namhaften Kunden und einer großen Nutzerbasis.
Sinnvolle Mission: Deine Arbeit trägt dazu bei, Wissenstransfer, Zusammenarbeit und menschliche Verbindungen in Unternehmen zu stärken.
Direkter Gestaltungsspielraum: Kurze Entscheidungswege und enge Zusammenarbeit mit Gründerteam, Mitarbeitenden, Kunden und Partnern.
Remote-first: Flexible Arbeit unabhängig vom klassischen Büroalltag.
Persönlicher Austausch: Regelmäßige Teamtreffen und gemeinsame Workations.
Faire Vergütung: Ein attraktives Vergütungsmodell aus fixen und erfolgsabhängigen Bestandteilen.
Langfristige Perspektive: Bei gegenseitigem Interesse besteht die Möglichkeit einer Beteiligung am Unternehmen.
Workation: Regelmäßige Treffen im Team, u. a. in Schweden.
Wir suchen keine Person, die lediglich bestehende Abläufe verwaltet. Wir suchen jemanden, der Verantwortung übernehmen, Entscheidungen treffen und gemeinsam mit einem kleinen Team etwas aufbauen möchte.
Wenn du Lust hast, aus einem etablierten HR-Tech-Produkt ein noch stärkeres, wachsendes Unternehmen zu entwickeln, möchten wir dich kennenlernen.

About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

Training and serving frontier AI models requires data center capacity at a scale and pace that conventional delivery models were not built for. Anthropic's Data Center Capacity Delivery team embeds with developers, general contractors, and third-party partners to take leased and partnered sites from deal close through floor access and operational handover as fast as they can safely be built.
As a Regional Manager, you'll own delivery across a regional portfolio of active and upcoming projects. You'll build and lead the team of Senior Delivery Managers and third-party partners who sit on those sites, set the standards they execute to, and step in yourself where a project needs it. You are the executive-level interface to our developer partners in the region and the intake point for projects handed over from our transaction team.
This is a highly cross-functional role: you'll work daily with our transaction, design engineering, facility operations and commissioning, deployment, and safety teams, and with developers, GCs, and owner's-representative firms on the ground.
MOC (Mission + Outcomes + Competencies)
Mission
Deliver the region’s data center projects to floor access as fast as they can safely be built.
Outcomes
Every active project in the region delivered against early-floor-access and floor-access milestones.
Senior Delivery Manager team hired and led; owner’s-rep partners contracted and managed.
Delivery standards (schedule, quality, change control, reporting) enforced across the portfolio.
Executive reporting on progress vs plan and regional capacity projections in place.
Competencies
Senior owner- or GC-side mission-critical delivery leadership.
Builds and leads multi-project teams.
Executive-level developer and GC relationship management.
Leads on site through presence; owns outcomes where no process exists.

Lead. This is a role where leadership trumps management and process. You are expected to be on the region's sites enough to shape the culture, approach, and aggressiveness that define the extended teams there — across the portfolio, not one project — and to impact outcomes in a favorable manner.
Be a force multiplier. Hire, develop, empower, and lead the Senior Delivery Managers on those sites, and raise the skillset developers, contractors, owner's-rep partners, and key trades bring to every project in the region; plan resourcing and headcount as the portfolio grows.
Own portfolio execution for the region — schedule, quality, and safety outcomes on every active project, measured against early-floor-access and floor-access milestones. You are empowered and have autonomy to own this regions record of performance.
Drive ownership and influence both inside and outside contractual structures: select, scope, contract, and manage owner's-rep and project-management partners; where contracts, incentives, or culture get in the way of speed, change them, and replace partners when performance or culture slips
Set and enforce delivery standards across projects — integrated schedule, quality requirements, change control, reporting, and tools — and validate that they are met
Identify blockers early and clear them across developer, GC, and trade layers; step in on site where a project needs it
You may be a good fit if you
Have [10+] years delivering data center or other mission-critical construction, including several as the owner's or GC's senior leader on a project campus
Have led a multi-project portfolio and built the team that delivered it
Know the end-to-end development process — entitlements and permitting, design, long-lead equipment, construction, commissioning, and handover — well enough to direct partners rather than take their word for it
Have managed developer, GC, and third-party relationships at the executive level and can move them from arm's-length contract administration to shared urgency
Lead through presence: you expect to be on site most of the time and to set the pace and culture of extended teams you don't directly employ
Communicate clearly with technical and non-specialist stakeholders and hold a position when challenged
Are comfortable with ambiguity and with owning outcomes where no process exists yet
Strong candidates may also have
Hyperscale data center delivery experience on the owner, developer, or GC side
Experience with the UK and continental European market — its contractors, permitting regimes, and contractual norms
Familiarity with lease, construction, and development contract structures and how to align their incentives around speed

Mission
Deliver the region’s data center projects to floor access as fast as they can safely be built.
Outcomes
Every active project in the region delivered against early-floor-access and floor-access milestones.
Senior Delivery Manager team hired and led; owner’s-rep partners contracted and managed.
Delivery standards (schedule, quality, change control, reporting) enforced across the portfolio.
Executive reporting on progress vs plan and regional capacity projections in place.
Competencies
Senior owner- or GC-side mission-critical delivery leadership.
Builds and leads multi-project teams.
Executive-level developer and GC relationship management.
Leads on site through presence; owns outcomes where no process exists.

Lead. This is a role where leadership trumps management and process. You are expected to be on the region's sites enough to shape the culture, approach, and aggressiveness that define the extended teams there — across the portfolio, not one project — and to impact outcomes in a favorable manner.

Own portfolio execution for the region — schedule, quality, and safety outcomes on every active project, measured against early-floor-access and floor-access milestones. You are empowered and have autonomy to own this region's record of performance.
Drive ownership and influence both inside and outside contractual structures: select, scope, contract, and manage owner's-rep and project-management partners; where contracts, incentives, or culture get in the way of speed, change them, and replace partners when performance or culture slips

The Apprenticeship and Training Series, GS-0243, has basic requirements for positions covered by this standard. Applicants must meet both the basic requirements (IOR) and Specialized Experience for the specific grade level to qualify.

Individual Occupational Requirement (IOR): Specialized Experience (for positions above GS-5): Experience in the development or administration of apprenticeship programs or other occupational training programs involving the systematic development of worker skills on the job.

This experience must have demonstrated: Knowledge of the functions, purposes, and practices of apprenticeship or other industrial training; and understanding of the knowledge, skills, and techniques involved in the practice of apprenticeable trades; Knowledge of the practices, operations, and content of occupations in one or more fields; Knowledge of training methods and related worker utilization practices for the improvement and better use of workers' skills; and the ability to apply this knowledge in identifying work force and training problems, analyzing such problems, and advising on their solution; Understanding of industrial relations problems and practices and of the traditions and attitudes of labor and management in relation to programs involving apprenticeship or other training on the job; and Ability to deal effectively with management, labor, and other appropriate officials on training matters.

Examples of qualifying specialized experience include: Working member of a functioning joint apprenticeship committee. Employer training official or officer of a union or trade association whose duties included the development or administration of an apprenticeship program or other industrial training program.

Coordinator or director of a training program for apprenticeable occupations or other training activities. Training representative or administrator in the field of apprenticeship, working with labor or management. Vocational teacher or instructor in an apprenticeable occupation.

In additional to meeting the IOR requirement, for the GS-15 grade level: You must meet the Specialized Experience to qualify for Apprenticeship and Training Representative, as described below. Applicants must have 52 weeks of specialized experience equivalent to at least the next lower grade level, GS-14, in the Federal Service or equivalent pay.

Specialized Experience is the experience that equipped the applicant with the particular knowledge, skills, and abilities (KSA's) to perform the duties of the position successfully, and that is typically in or related to the position to be filled.

To be creditable, specialized experience must have been equivalent to at least the next lower grade level.

Qualifying specialized experience for GS-15 includes at least four (4) of the following: Providing executive-level leadership and guidance on policy, strategy, program goals, and resources; Overseeing apprenticeship or comparable training programs across a regional or multi-state area and ensuring alignment with priorities; Managing the administration, expansion, or modernization of programs through subordinate managers; Developing and evaluating policies, goals, performance measures, and operations for complex programs; Supervising managers responsible for multi-state or multi-program operations and major initiatives; Making decisions on significant program, policy, or resource issues, including complex or sensitive matters.
